question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"chosen."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The sentence describes a situation where in order to have access to transportation routes, fishing, and water for farming, industry, and drinking, many people have made the decision to live close to bodies of water. • "Chosen" means to decide which thing or person you want out of the ones that are available. (उपलब्‍ध वस्‍तुओं या व्‍यक्तियों में से चयन या चुनाव करना; चुनना) • Example:* He was **chosen**__ by them.* • Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2." • Correct passage: A flood occurs when water overflows its natural __barriers__ and lands on typically dry ground. Floods have always been an __unavoidable__ component of life on the planet. A legend about a __huge__ flood exists in almost every civilisation. Many people have __**chosen**__** **to live near bodies of water in order to have access to transportation routes, fishing, and water for drinking, farming, and industry. The majority of the world's major cities are ______ (5) ______ on or near oceans, lakes, or rivers. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ • Looking at other options: • **Avoided: **to prevent something happening or to try not to do something. (कुछ होने से रोकना; कुछ करने से बचना) • **Conquered: **to take control of a country or city and its people by force, especially in a war. (युद्घ में किसी देश को जीतना; उस पर अधिकार करना) • **Left: **to go away from somebody/something. (किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से दूर जाना) 41:T13b0, The correct answer is "located."
